_readme: T10Link bridge settings. Most setup is on the web page: http://<this machine>:2401. After editing this file by hand: t10link restart
_thermostats: One entry per thermostat; the web page (port web_port) adds, names and removes them. Its position in this list (1, 2, 3 ...) is its ThermostatAddress in Blueprint. By hand: [{"ip": "192.168.1.50", "name": "Living Room"}, {"ip": "192.168.1.51"}]
